purpose: Fresh, purchase-intent candidate research prepared after the Aug 27 strict publication gate completed. No queue IDs are created here; final materialization must still pass semantic-duplicate and source-freshness gates.

evidence.source: 2026 White Paper on Small Enterprises in Japan, Part 1
evidence.publisher: Small and Medium Enterprise Agency, Japan
evidence.observed: Among small businesses, expansion of orders/sales is the most frequently selected top management issue at 36.6%; securing human resources is also a major issue.

evidence.source: 2026 White Paper on Small Enterprises in Japan, Part 2 Chapter 1
evidence.publisher: Small and Medium Enterprise Agency, Japan
evidence.observed: For employee attendance management among surveyed small businesses, 49.8% use handwritten paper and 30.3% use spreadsheet software, indicating a large manual/spreadsheet workflow base.
AI adoption is expanding, but realized effects remain concentrated in operational efficiency and speed; progression to new value creation remains limited.
The official labor-saving support portal expanded to additional industries on 2026-08-26 and emphasizes industry-specific productivity and back-office improvement.

candidateClusters.paidNoteCandidate: 月末の勤怠締めで慌てない｜打刻漏れ・重複・長時間労働を締日前に潰す実務フロー
candidateClusters.boothCandidate: 勤怠締め異常チェックOS｜打刻漏れ・重複・長時間労働の確認テンプレート
candidateClusters.freeNoteCandidate: 勤怠集計で月末に起きやすい5つの異常｜締日前に見る場所だけ整理
candidateClusters.demandRationale: Official 2026 data shows roughly four in five small businesses still manage attendance with paper or spreadsheets, creating recurring month-end checking work.
candidateClusters.paidPromise: A repeatable close process, exception categories, escalation rules and a reusable spreadsheet/checklist rather than generic labor-law commentary.
candidateClusters.boothAsset: Excel/CSV-ready exception list, monthly close checklist, correction request log, escalation matrix and sample rows.
candidateClusters.duplicateRisk: low based on Aug 26-27 manifests; must still scan full recent inventory before materialization

candidateClusters.paidNoteCandidate: 見積を出した後に放置しない｜受注フォローを属人化させない案件管理ルール
candidateClusters.boothCandidate: 見積→受注フォロー管理OS｜次回連絡日・失注理由・追客漏れ防止テンプレート
candidateClusters.demandRationale: Expansion of orders/sales is the top cited management issue for small businesses in the 2026 white paper; follow-up discipline is directly tied to conversion without requiring ad spend.
candidateClusters.paidPromise: Defines follow-up timing, next-action ownership, stale-deal detection and loss-reason capture for small teams.
candidateClusters.boothAsset: Pipeline sheet, follow-up queue, stale-opportunity flags, loss-reason taxonomy and weekly review sheet.
candidateClusters.duplicateRisk: medium; scan recent sales/CRM/lead-management inventory before materialization

candidateClusters.paidNoteCandidate: 応募者を待たせない｜採用の返信漏れ・面接調整漏れを防ぐ小規模チーム運用
candidateClusters.boothCandidate: 採用応募対応OS｜返信期限・面接調整・選考停滞の見える化テンプレート
candidateClusters.demandRationale: Securing human resources remains a major management issue in the 2026 small-business survey; small teams benefit from a lightweight operational control rather than a full ATS.
candidateClusters.paidPromise: SLA-based applicant handling, ownership, stage aging and handoff rules without requiring a paid recruiting system.
candidateClusters.boothAsset: Applicant tracker, response-deadline flags, interview coordination sheet, stage-aging review and rejection/hold reason codes.

candidateClusters.paidNoteCandidate: AI導入を『便利だった』で終わらせない｜業務時間・品質・再作業を測る効果検証設計
candidateClusters.boothCandidate: AI業務改善ROI測定OS｜導入前後の時間・品質・再作業・利用率を記録するテンプレート
candidateClusters.freeNoteCandidate: AI導入が『効率化止まり』になる3つのサイン｜効果検証で最初に決める数字
candidateClusters.demandRationale: IPA's July 2026 survey says AI adoption is spreading but effects remain concentrated in efficiency/speed, making measurement and operationalization a current business need.
candidateClusters.paidPromise: A pragmatic before/after measurement model with baselines, guardrails and review cadence; no unsupported ROI promises.
candidateClusters.boothAsset: Baseline sheet, weekly measurement log, quality/rework fields, adoption tracking, experiment decision log and summary dashboard inputs.
candidateClusters.duplicateRisk: low-to-medium; scan recent AI productivity/ROI inventory

candidateClusters.paidNoteCandidate: 省力化は『ツール選び』から始めない｜小規模事業者のバックオフィス改善優先順位の付け方
candidateClusters.boothCandidate: バックオフィス省力化診断OS｜手間・頻度・ミス損失から改善順を決めるテンプレート
candidateClusters.demandRationale: SME Support Japan expanded its labor-saving portal on 2026-08-26, reinforcing current policy and business focus on practical productivity improvement across industries.
candidateClusters.paidPromise: Prioritize workflows by frequency, time cost, error impact, automation fit and implementation burden before buying tools.

selectionPolicy.rule: Materialize only after comparing against recent published titles, promises and asset schemas. If a candidate is semantically close to an Aug 22-27 product, replace it rather than cosmetically renaming it.
